engines.name: Kokoro 82M
engines.source: PyPI package kokoro; model files from the publisher's Hugging Face repo
engines.french: A separate French voice (ff_siwis). The English voices do not speak French.
notes: Same text gives the same audio every time, so a line can be regenerated exactly.
No voice cloning and no emotion control. Only the voices that ship with it.
The English text front end fetches a small spaCy language model (en_core_web_sm, MIT) on first run.

engines.name: Chatterbox Multilingual
engines.source: PyPI package chatterbox-tts 0.1.7, installed without its pinned PyTorch 2.6, which cannot drive this graphics card; model files from the publisher's Hugging Face repo
engines.french: The same model in French mode, with either voice.

voices.label: Demo voice · English, female
voices.source: the publisher's own demo reference clip, 3 seconds; its speaker and licence are not stated

voices.label: Demo voice · French, female
voices.source: the publisher's own demo reference clip, 7 seconds; its speaker and licence are not stated

notes: Random by nature: the same text gives different audio on each run unless the seed is fixed.
Every output carries the publisher's inaudible watermark.
The publisher retired the project in August 2026: no more updates. A newer v3 model exists only in the source repository, not in the PyPI package, so it was not used.
Any voice other than the built-in one is made by imitating a short reference recording.

skipped.name: Higgs Audio V3
skipped.licence: Research and non-commercial licence for the model
skipped.reason: it could not be run here within the rules. The publisher only supports it through a Linux server stack inside Docker, which this Windows PC does not have and cannot get without an administrator prompt. The serving package on PyPI does not install (it needs a build of its core that is not on PyPI). The publisher has confirmed it on 40 GB of graphics memory and calls 24 GB unverified; 16 GB is only reached by third-party shrunken copies. It also ships no voices: every voice is an imitation of a reference recording.

page_notes: Chatterbox's demo voices imitate short reference recordings from its publisher's own demo page. Kokoro's voices ship with it.

line_notes.5: A stress test: an Icelandic place name and a French phrase, read in English mode.
line_notes.6: French mode. Kokoro uses its separate French voice here; Chatterbox uses the same model as for English.
